dogecoin.text: @CrptoVIPsignal @bogecoin is a newly released cryptocurrency on Binance Smart Chain network that aims to create an improved version of the original Dogecoin. It's working product is @vote_bsc, a voting platform and launch pad for new #BSC projects.
